body:
A batched `COPY ... TO` given `ROW_GROUP_SIZE_BYTES` without `ROW_GROUP_SIZE` fails:

```sql
SET threads=2;
CREATE TABLE t AS FROM range(1000000);
COPY t TO 'out.csv' (ROW_GROUP_SIZE_BYTES '256KB');
-- INTERNAL Error: Attempting to get the index of an optional_idx that is not set
```

`CorrectSizeForBatch` calls `batch_size.GetIndex()` without checking that a row target is set. It is
reached for the leftover batch of a non-final repartition, so the error depends on timing: the
query above failed on every run at 2 threads here (tested on Linux x86_64; Apple ARM64).

With no row target, the byte target now decides, through `CopyFunctionBatchAnalyzer::IsAcceptable()`,
as it does elsewhere. The new test
(`test/sql/copy/csv/batched_write/batch_csv_row_group_size_bytes.test`) fails before the fix and
passes after.

## Demonstration
